title: Dexcom G6 and 8Gxxxx transmitter: Sensor error
symptom: After pairing and starting a Dexcom G6 sensor, the phone service state reports 'got data from G6' and warming up, but on the next connection attempt it hangs in 'Connect request' and then reports 'Got no raw' with sensor status changing to 'Sensor Errors', eventually going into 'Sensor failed 6'. The issue was reproduced on three different hardware configurations.
cause: The 'Sensor Errors' message comes from the transmitter and indicates the transmitter isn't happy with the signal coming from the sensor, suggesting a bad sensor or insertion.
fix: The user applied a new sensor, which started working right after the warmup period. The maintainer suggested that the error often settles down or indicates a bad sensor/insertion.
evidence_quote: If you're getting the Sensor Errors message then this is coming from the transmitter and your link between xDrip and the transmitter is fine. The message implies that the transmitter isn't happy with the signal coming from the sensor.
